subject.title: WebChat TTS: add explicit routing/playback logs and user-visible delivery status

question: Should WebChat TTS diagnostics become a durable Gateway event/UI status contract now, and which boundary owns route, delivery, and browser-playback status?
rationale: The requested behavior adds observable event names and UI status semantics; source shows the current implementation lacks them, but choosing the event schema and status ownership is maintainer product/API intent.

options.title: Define Gateway Delivery Contract
options.body: Add correlated generation, route, and delivery events at the Gateway/WebChat media boundary, with UI status derived from that delivery state.

options.title: Defer Until Playback PR Lands
options.body: Wait for the adjacent WebChat final-media PR to settle before deciding where the route/delivery telemetry should attach.

options.title: Logs Only
options.body: Keep the work limited to structured Gateway logs and leave user-visible delivery status for a later UX decision.

recommendation.title: Define Gateway Delivery Contract
recommendation.body: Add correlated generation, route, and delivery events at the Gateway/WebChat media boundary, with UI status derived from that delivery state.

likelyOwner.reason: The current TTS diagnostics surface descends from this contributor's provider-attempt analytics work, making them the best available routing candidate for the event/status shape.
